description: How to run each GUI-lane case without a person deciding anything. The sibling of config/runs.json, which does the same job for the web lane. A case file says what a case proves; this says which module drives it, what stage it stops at, and what it writes. gui_tests/run.py reads it. A case absent from this file cannot be launched by id, which is deliberate: guessing a stage means writing the wrong thing to a live client.

TC-014.summary: Term loan through month-end accrual (TPM44) and valuation (TPM1), SAP GUI for Windows
TC-014.writes: 5 writes - create, settle, post, accrue, value. With --rows: 5 writes per selected row
TC-014.resumeNote: --resume <deal> skips FTR_CREATE and settles/posts that deal instead of creating a second one. Only for the single-deal path (no --rows) - a batch run has no one deal to resume against; re-run with --rows limited to what scripts/check-run.ps1 -Latest shows is still missing.
TC-014.note: GUI-lane sibling of TC-009 (web lane). Same business flow and data, different rendering path - the two are not interchangeable as evidence. --rows is opt-in (no defaultRows set here, so the plain command still drives the single BASELINE deal unchanged): pass --rows with row ids from test-data/term-loan-accrual-valuation-batch.dataset.json (or 'all') to run one full lifecycle per row instead - the same 10-row dataset TC-012 (web lane) already drives, added 2026-08-21.

TC-015.summary: Term loan with VARIABLE interest (RBI_REPO, monthly) created in FTR_CREATE, SAP GUI for Windows
TC-015.writes: 1 write - creates one interest rate instrument (term loan, variable interest on RBI_REPO, monthly). Nothing is settled or posted
TC-015.resumeNote: --resume is refused: this case is create-only, so there is no later stage to resume into. A quiet no-op would look like a pass.
TC-015.note: GUI-lane sibling of TC-013 (web lane). Reference interest rate RBI_REPO is a DATA decision chosen from the field's live F4 list, not a discoverable default - change it in the case module, never in gui_tests/modules/treasury.py. -Stage entry and -Stage fill write nothing, so they are this case's harness smoke test.

TC-016.summary: Term loan with VARIABLE interest and a parameterised interest period (monthly / quarterly / half-yearly) in FTR_CREATE, SAP GUI for Windows
TC-016.writes: 1 write per selected row - creates one interest rate instrument per row (term loan, variable interest on RBI_REPO, interest period set by the row). Nothing is settled or posted
TC-016.resumeNote: --resume is refused: this case is create-only, so there is no later stage to resume into. A quiet no-op would look like a pass.
TC-016.note: Sibling of TC-015, not a replacement: TC-015 accepts the interest period the screen defaults to, this one SETS it. The period is a COUNT OF MONTHS, not a frequency key - SAP's Frequency dropdown has no quarterly or half-yearly entry on DS4/100 (read live 2026-08-19) and its unit dropdown is locked to Months. Add a period by adding a row to test-data/term-loan-variable-period.dataset.json, never by editing gui_tests/modules/treasury.py. -Stage entry and -Stage fill write nothing, so they are this case's harness smoke test.

TC-018.summary: FWZZ create a Class for product type 26B (Inv: Mutual Funds), Issuer 700000453 / INR, SAP GUI for Windows
TC-018.writes: 1 write - creates one new Class, server-assigned id
TC-018.resumeNote: --resume is refused: this case is create-only, so there is no later stage to resume into. A quiet no-op would look like a pass.
TC-018.note: GUI-lane sibling of TC-017 (web lane). Same product type, same mock data (Issuer 700000453, currency INR), different rendering path - the two are not interchangeable as evidence. Every id in gui_tests/screens/fwzz-*.json came from live SAP GUI Scripting discovery on DS4/100, 2026-08-19, not carried over from the web lane's DOM ids. -Stage entry, -Stage dialog and -Stage basic write nothing, so they are this case's harness smoke test.

TC-020.summary: FWZZ create a Class (26B) then FTR_CREATE an Investment transaction against it, co.code 9990, SAP GUI for Windows
TC-020.writes: creates one new Class and one Investment transaction against it (2 writes)
TC-020.resumeNote: --resume is refused: this case always creates a fresh class and deal, so there is no later stage to resume into. A quiet no-op would look like a pass.
TC-020.note: GUI-lane sibling of TC-019 (web lane). Same product type, same mock data, different rendering path. The FTR_CREATE deal screen turned out to be the exact same program (SAPLTTM_UI_FRAMEWORK) on both lanes with the identical Enter/Save/Enter commit sequence - confirmed live 2026-08-20. Every id in gui_tests/screens/{ftr-entry,ftr-26b-deal}.json came from live SAP GUI Scripting discovery, not carried over from the web lane's DOM ids.

TC-021.summary: Term loan with VARIABLE interest (RBI_REPO, monthly) through settlement, TBB1 post, month-end accrual (TPM44) and valuation (TPM1), SAP GUI for Windows
TC-021.writes: 5 writes - create, settle, post, accrue, value
TC-021.resumeNote: --resume <deal> skips FTR_CREATE and settles/posts that deal instead of creating a second one.
TC-021.note: Combines TC-015's variable-interest deal fill (fill_term_loan_variable/VariableRateTerms) with TC-014's settle->TBB1->TPM44->TPM1 lifecycle (settle_deal/post_flows/run_accrual_deferral/run_valuation) - both reused unchanged from gui_tests/modules/treasury.py. Neither TC-014 (fixed interest) nor TC-015 (variable, create-only) covers this combination.

TC-022.summary: Term loan with FIXED interest (8%, On Last Day of Month) plus a second interest condition (9% eff. 20.08.2026), through settlement, TBB1 post, month-end accrual (TPM44) and valuation (TPM1), SAP GUI for Windows
TC-022.writes: 5 writes - create, settle, post, accrue, value
TC-022.resumeNote: --resume <deal> skips FTR_CREATE and settles/posts that deal instead of creating a second one.
TC-022.note: Reuses TC-014's fixed-rate lifecycle (fill_term_loan/settle_deal/post_flows/run_accrual_deferral/run_valuation) and adds one genuinely new piece: add_interest_condition (gui_tests/modules/treasury.py), which drives the deal screen's 'Conditions' -> 'Copy condition' flow to add a later-dated rate change before the deal is ever saved. Discovered live on DS4/100, 2026-08-24 - not present in any earlier case. fill_term_loan also gained an optional frequency/frequency_key pair for this case (On Last Day of Month); TC-014's call is unaffected since both default to None.

TC-023.summary: Term loan with VARIABLE interest (RBI_REPO, monthly) through settlement and TBB1 post, then month-end accrual (TPM44) and valuation (TPM1) for EVERY month of the term (01.2026-12.2026), SAP GUI for Windows
TC-023.writes: 27 writes - create, settle, post, then 12 x (accrue + value), one pair per month-end
TC-023.resumeNote: --resume <deal> skips FTR_CREATE and settles/posts/re-runs the full month loop against that deal instead of creating a second one. settle_deal/post_flows/run_accrual_deferral/run_valuation are all idempotent against a month already done (SAP itself reports 'already settled'/'no flows exist'/'already run'), so resuming does not double-post.
TC-023.note: Sibling of TC-021, not a replacement: TC-021 deliberately stops after one month-end (31.01.2026); this case answers the same lifecycle for the WHOLE term, looping TPM44 then TPM1 once per calendar month-end from the term start through the term end (12 pairs for this baseline). Same deal profile and create/settle/post lifecycle as TC-021, reused unchanged from gui_tests/modules/treasury.py - only the tpm stage differs.
